revision_note: schema_version 6 repairs an unsatisfiable acceptance condition, after the development H2H was run and scored but BEFORE any sealed access. Change vs 5: the v5 evidence-superiority condition named four endpoints and required two to show a paired improvement excluding zero, but citation_integrity and contract_completion are undefined for a no-contract comparator and may not be imputed as zero, so only two were ever testable and the condition silently demanded both. v6 classifies every endpoint as architectural (reported as counts, never tested), inferential (defined for every arm AND not architecturally determined), or supporting; registers two inferential families -- evidence-use and alignment -- whose membership follows that stated rule and therefore INCLUDES three endpoints MedGuard loses; registers scope-matched faithfulness with its asymmetry disclosed and its unrestricted companion mandatory; and registers both denominators for verifiable-citation coverage. The development verdict stands as measured under v5 (condition not met vs B1, met only vs B5) and is not restated under v6. Everything else is retained: thesis, arm roster, ablation matrix, frozen artifacts, diagnosis endpoints, alpha 0.05, 2000 lesion-clustered replicates at seed 20260712, Holm within family. Paired with EXPERIMENT_SPEC_V6.json and its receipt.

design_freeze.meaning: The thesis, comparison structure, ablation logic, endpoints, and change-control rules are frozen. Artifact, implementation-card, model, scorer, and budget fields remain pending and must be pinned before any current-paper generation or sealed-test access.
design_freeze.change_control: Any substantive design change requires a new protocol/specification version and a written reason; v1 is never silently overwritten after result viewing.

datasets: HAM10000 internal development and sealed confirmatory test

bcn_label_policy.shared_taxonomy_multiclass: Report seven-class metrics only on BCN records in the shared HAM taxonomy; SCC is excluded from this table and the denominator is reported.
bcn_label_policy.actionable_binary: Retain SCC as actionable together with melanoma, BCC, and AKIEC; never merge SCC into AKIEC.
bcn_label_policy.claim_boundary: BCN has already been inspected during architecture development and is not an untouched external confirmation.

thesis: A cross-modal evidence contract with provenance-preserving retrieval, structured verification, and bounded failure-typed remediation yields more auditable evidence use without sacrificing diagnostic performance under a matched budget.
novelty_boundary: The operational evidence contract, cross-modal lineage receipt, failure taxonomy, bounded remediation, and matched measurement package are candidate contributions.
Knowledge graphs, provenance, CATIA/GRiP, and NIST AI RMF are not novel by themselves.
Provenance establishes origin and lineage, not content truth.

primary_arm_roster.adaptive_slot: Exactly one of B2, B3, or B4 is promoted before H2H outputs are viewed, using implementation fidelity and feasibility only; the others are appendix/reference arms if implemented.

ablation_study.design: paired leave-one-component-out on identical lesion cases, plus B1 as the practical no-contract comparator

arms.name: without image-exemplar retrieval
arms.removal: Remove the patient-image exemplar evidence branch while retaining the frozen perception output and shared guideline/text retrieval.
arms.purpose: isolate the contribution of cross-modal hybrid evidence retrieval

arms.name: without graph relations
arms.removal: Replace graph traversal and lineage edges with a flat evidence list; retain source identifiers, versions, retrieval paths, and content hashes.
arms.purpose: isolate graph/lineage structure without pretending provenance itself proves truth

arms.name: without remediation
arms.removal: Disable EXPAND, REFORMULATE, and INDEPENDENT_SOURCE; perform one retrieval/generation/verification pass and ABSTAIN when the contract is not satisfied.

arms.name: without verifier gating
arms.removal: Keep host schema/provenance binding and score verification observably, but do not let evidence-verification results trigger repair or abstention. Malformed structured output remains a generation error and never becomes PASS.
arms.purpose: isolate structured verification as a decision gate

ablation_study.no_contract_comparator: B1 uses the same frozen perception output, text corpus, generator, decoding, and top-k budget but emits a conventional single-pass answer instead of an EvidenceContract.

optional_action_ablations.eligibility: Run a disable-one-action analysis only when A0 triggers that action on at least 30 distinct development lesions before outcomes are inspected.
optional_action_ablations.fallback: If fewer than 30 lesions trigger the action, report the count descriptively and do not claim an action-specific effect.

fairness: same cases, frozen perception outputs, corpus snapshot, candidate pool, generator, decoding, seeds, and maximum budget
removed components receive no compensating extra calls or tokens
report actual calls, tokens, latency, errors, abstentions, and answered coverage
contract-completion is not applicable for B1 and is never imputed as zero
A4 is not a deployable configuration and may only be evaluated offline

failure_typed_development_suite.role: mechanism evaluation, not prevalence or clinical-harm estimation
failure_typed_development_suite.minimum_for_inferential_stratum_claim: 30 distinct development lesion clusters per F1-F4; smaller strata are descriptive only
failure_typed_development_suite.sealed_test_rule: No artificial failure is selected, tuned, or injected using sealed-test outcomes.

primary_outcomes.diagnosis_hypothesis: superiority of the M-family over the B0 VLM baseline on the competed diagnosis axis (schema_version 5); noninferiority among the M-family holds by construction because they share the frozen probe
primary_outcomes.provenance_scoring: citation_integrity is scored over the host-built contract's guideline citations (source-exact provenance guarantee; 1.0 for covered M-family lesions, None for baselines). It is not a generator-faithfulness test -- that is RAGAS (supporting). Guideline citations are host-owned; the VLM cannot invoke the source-statement-integrity registry.

demoted_from_primary.faithfulness: ragas_faithfulness is now a supporting endpoint, not primary. RAGAS is validated only on Wikipedia (WikiEval, 50 pages, 0.70 annotator agreement) with no clinical validation and no implementation here yet; staking a primary endpoint on it is a liability. It remains under required_supporting_outputs for comparability.
demoted_from_primary.citation_precision: Replaced by citation_integrity as the provenance primary. Under committed-diagnosis-scoped retrieval a citation can only name a record of the committed condition, so precision-vs-condition is 1.0 by construction and measures nothing. Integrity checks that a cited id resolves to the exact source/version/citation/content hash and was in the offered candidate set (medguard/eval/citation_integrity.py); it is never compared to MedGraphRAG's human-judged citation precision of 92.

required_supporting_outputs: accuracy, balanced accuracy, weighted F1, MCC, Cohen kappa, per-class metrics
binary actionable confusion matrix and AUROC
coverage, selective accuracy, risk-coverage curve and abstention rate
RAGAS faithfulness (demoted from primary), answer relevancy, context precision and context recall
citation recall (supporting; citation_integrity is the primary provenance endpoint), claim support, image-claim consistency and unresolved contradiction rate
calls, tokens, latency and coverage-adjusted utility
paired leave-one-component-out ablation table with confidence intervals

statistics.bootstrap_method: percentile, resampling whole lesion/patient clusters (eval/statistics.py clustered_bootstrap_ci)
statistics.test_sidedness: two-sided for superiority endpoints; one-sided noninferiority at the stated absolute margin
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm step-down family-wise correction within each pre-specified endpoint family; family membership is frozen before development H2H. This reconciles the earlier procedure-only wording ('freeze the family') with the Holm rule in EXPERIMENT_SPEC: freeze the family AND Holm-correct within it when more than one comparison is inferential.
statistics.matched_coverage_ceiling_rule: Fixed before the sealed run as the minimum answered-coverage achieved by any primary arm on the 160-lesion development set, floored to the nearest 0.05, then applied identically to every arm's partial risk/harm-coverage AUC. The value cannot exist before the arms run; the rule is what is pre-registered.

power_and_precision.diagnosis_under_frozen_perception: Under the shared frozen perception commitment every arm receives the identical diagnostic commitment, so macro_f1 and accuracy are equal across arms by construction and diagnostic noninferiority holds exactly, not statistically. The 0.01 absolute margin governs only a future variant in which arms diagnose independently.
power_and_precision.per_case_endpoints: For a single arm's per-case accuracy at p=0.76 the 95% CI half-width over 1495 lesions is about +/-0.022 (standard error ~0.011); the paired A-minus-B difference is smaller and discordance-dependent, roughly +/-0.016 to +/-0.020. Both exceed the 0.01 noninferiority margin, so in any future independent-diagnosis variant the margin is assessed by the realized clustered-bootstrap interval and only larger departures are detectable at 1495 lesions.
power_and_precision.actionable_sensitivity: At HAM10000's published overall actionable prevalence (~19%; a dataset-composition prior, not a sealed-label read) roughly 280 of 1495 sealed lesions are actionable, giving an estimated +/-0.04 95% CI half-width on sensitivity at 90% fixed specificity.
power_and_precision.non_per_case_endpoints: macro_f1, aurc and citation_integrity are not per-case statistics, so a priori power is not asserted for them; their precision is pre-registered to be reported as realized 2000-replicate lesion-clustered bootstrap CI widths rather than a fabricated power number.

statistics.abstentions: reported separately from answered-case diagnosis metrics
statistics.ablation_reporting: paired full-minus-ablation differences with clustered intervals; no pooled average across incompatible endpoints

freeze_requirements: corpus, index, source-policy and citation-identifier hashes
source-tree revision or deterministic source-tree receipt
one implementation card per primary arm and ablation
adaptive-slot selection receipt created before H2H outputs
generator, judge, prompts, seeds, retries and budgets
stop_conditions: materially incomplete rival labeled as a reproduction
scorer changes after sealed outputs are viewed

provenance treated as proof of correctness
authorization: No paid generation or sealed-test run is authorized by this design freeze.

endpoint_classification_rule.test_1_defined_for_every_arm: a no-contract baseline must have a real value; imputing zero is forbidden
endpoint_classification_rule.test_2_not_architecturally_determined: an arm lacking MedGuard's machinery must still have been able to win it
endpoint_classification_rule.failing_either: reported as a descriptive count, never as a hypothesis test

registered_inferential_families.membership_rule_precedes_membership: The rule was stated before the members were listed and admits endpoints MedGuard loses -- answer relevancy, completeness and copy-reference all favour the baselines and are members for that reason.

acceptance_condition.A_diagnosis: M-family non-inferiority by construction plus superiority over B0 with a paired interval excluding zero
acceptance_condition.B_evidence_use: at least two evidence-use members improve with Holm-corrected 95% clustered-bootstrap intervals excluding zero, against B1 specifically
acceptance_condition.C_full_disclosure: every family member reported with direction and interval
acceptance_condition.D_regressions_bounded: no evidence-use member may regress; alignment regressions are permitted with a stated mechanism
acceptance_condition.E_no_hidden_coverage_win: unconditional and answered-only figures for every coverage-sensitive endpoint
